response: To make scrambled eggs, crack 2-3 eggs into a bowl and beat them with a fork or whisk. Add a splash of milk or water for a creamier texture. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and add butter. Once the butter is melted and bubbly, pour in the eggs. Stir constantly with a spatula until the eggs are set but still slightly runny. Season with salt and pepper to taste, and serve immediately.
